name: How can I prepare my home for a remodeling project?
description: Clear the work area, secure valuables, and discuss access and utilities with your contractor.

mainEntity.name: How can I prepare my home for a remodeling project?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prepare your home, clear the work area of personal belongings, valuables, and furniture. If possible, set up a temporary living space for areas being remodeled. Discuss access points and utility shut-off locations with your contractor to ensure a smooth start to the project.
